thread.title: UBS Group Reiterates $185.00 Price Target for Apple (AAPL)

author: Trevor Kearing
title: UBS Group Reiterates $185.00 Price Target for Apple (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
UBS Group set a $185.00 price objective on Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research note published on Monday, www.benzinga.com reports. The firm currently has a buy rating on the iPhone maker’s stock.
A number of other equities research analysts have also weighed in on the stock. Wedbush raised shares of Apple to an outperform rating and reduced their target price for the stock from $310.00 to $275.00 in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Morgan Stanley boosted their target price on shares of Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the stock an overweight rating in a report on Thursday, November 8th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a buy rating in a report on Monday, October 29th. Citigroup reduced their target price on shares of Apple from $240.00 to $200.00 and set a buy rating on the stock in a report on Monday, December 10th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada reissued a buy rating and set a $240.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, November 19th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the company. The company has a consensus rating of Hold and a consensus target price of $192.90. Get Apple alerts:
AAPL opened at $165.25 on Monday. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $142.00 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. The company has a market cap of $768.24 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.87, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.51 and a beta of 1.23. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The firm had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $84.07 billion. Equities research analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.89 EPS for the current fiscal year.
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 14th. Investors of record on Monday, February 11th will be paid a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.77%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is presently 24.52%.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . 0.05% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.
A number of hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of the stock. Morgan Stanley raised its holdings in Apple by 9.7% during the third quarter. Morgan Stanley now owns 39,188,032 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,846,307,000 after buying an additional 3,452,792 shares during the last quarter. TIAA CREF Investment Management LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 1.8% in the 3rd quarter. TIAA CREF Investment Management LLC now owns 26,144,522 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,901,864,000 after purchasing an additional 454,086 shares during the last quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 18.8% in the 3rd quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,833,222 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,703,027,000 after purchasing an additional 3,293,674 shares during the last quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 6.5% in the 2nd quarter. Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Holdings Inc. now owns 17,008,496 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,148,443,000 after purchasing an additional 1,030,981 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Swiss National Bank raised its position in Apple by 1.8% in the 2nd quarter. Swiss National Bank now owns 16,874,216 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $3,123,586,000 after buying an additional 304,600 shares during the last quarter. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
